tools.name: list_digests
tools.description: Newest-first list of every published energypod.io edition (weekly energy-industry digests): slug (YYYY-MM-DD), week label, and episode count. Call this FIRST — the first entry is the latest week, and its slug feeds get_digest / list_digest_episodes.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Full briefing markdown + metadata for one edition. ``slug`` is the YYYY-MM-DD edition date from list_digests; omitting it returns the LATEST edition. tools.name: list_digest_episodes
tools.description: The episodes a given edition references (title + show + published date + episode ids) — the cheapest way to map a week. Omitting ``slug`` returns the latest edition's episodes. Pass ``region`` for a region's reading list (the regional pilot, same as the site's ?region=); the payload's ``regions`` li

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: One episode's title, show, summary, and full transcript. Scoped to episodes referenced by a published digest. Pass ``digest`` when an episode spans more than one week. Pass ``lang`` (es / zh) for the episode's translated title, summary, and transcript when the translations exist — ``lang`` in the pa

tools.name: search
tools.description: Typo-tolerant search across digests, episodes, people, companies, and channels (same ranking + excerpts as the site's /search). Use for ad-hoc discovery when you don't know which edition or episode id you need.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_digest" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
